blocks.text: Vakils carry the hill chiefs’ challenge to Banda, but he answers without hesitation and offers terms so direct that the issue becomes almost one of single combat and tested courage.
He tells them they may bring imperial troops if they wish, yet insists that strength will be proven openly, not through evasive intrigue.
The page moves from fearful plotting to declared terms, turning rumor into a formal challenge.
